name: cytosol
meaning: Species listed here are pools buffered by the cytosol: their potential is fixed by the medium (ground), so they are folded into the medium vertex rather than kept as items. This is a declaration, not a finding; change the list and every downstream number changes with it.

medium_window.meaning: The eluent of the cytosol: the conditions under which chemical-reference Delta_r G deg values are Legendre-transformed. Typical cytosolic values, not measured for this kernel. T is 298.15 K because the TECRDB values are not temperature-corrected (T window 293-313 K).
medium_window.accessible_volume_meaning: convention accessible-volume: mu = mu deg + RT ln(c/a), one a for every small solute; 0.7 is a generous lower bound (macromolecules occupy up to about 30% of the cytosol, and small solutes reach more than the free volume)
